newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: New Toyo placement tranche fully taken up - DBS.
newsitem.headline: New Toyo placement tranche fully taken up - DBS.

text.p: The placement tranche of 10.8 million shares offered by paper products and packaging materials company New Toyo International Holdings Ltd has been fully taken up, placement agent DBS Bank said on Wednesday.

"The demand for the placement shares has been very good. All the placement shares have been taken up," Kan Shik Lum, senior vice president of DBS Bank, told reporters at New Toyo's initial public offering launch.
New Toyo is offering 54 million new shares at Singapore S$0.80 each, of which 10.8 million shares were allocated for placement to institutions and sophisticated investors.
DBS Bank is also the manager and underwriter of the issue.
The public offer closes on April 2 and is expected to start trading on a "when issued" basis on April 4.
